updates.title: Why 433 Students Are Marked "Promoted" (Missing Internal/Practical)
updates.desc: According to our data analysis, 47.4% of Tata College students received "Promoted" due to unsubmitted Internal/Practical marks (marked AB) in 7 departments & Minor papers.
updates.descHtml:
Disclaimer: KolhanHub is an independent student resource portal and not an official college/university source. The following points are purely statistical observations from the published provisional marks dataset (as of 02 Nov 2026).

1. What Our Data Indicates (Probable Cause):In 32 of 34 KU colleges, Semester 7 results were published with complete internal & practical marks (~88.6% university pass rate). At Tata College, 433 out of 914 students (47.4%) are currently marked Promoted (Credit 4 or 16) because Internal and/or Practical marks appear as AB in the initial provisional tabulation.
2. Affected Departments (100% Promoted due to Missing Internal/Practical):
  • Major Departments (0% Pass): Geography (63), Mathematics (52), Chemistry (45), English (37), Anthropology (32), Zoology — Practical omitted (32), Philosophy (5).
  • Minor Paper Spillover: Physics Major (34) and Computer Application (4) students had complete Major marks, but were marked Promoted (16 Credits) because their Minor - ID - Mathematics internal marks were recorded as AB. Similarly, Botany Major (6) students taking Minor - ID - Chemistry were affected.
3. Unaffected Departments (Normal Results):Departments where internal marks were reflected on time achieved normal pass rates: Hindi (87.6%), Ho (87.3%), Economics (83.6%), Urdu (80.0%), Psychology (79.6%), Political Science (77.3%), and History (72.5%).
